summary: Full backend + mobile web frontend regression run for AnyControl Remote. 17/17 pytest backend tests pass (auth incl. duplicate/short-password/invalid-token cases, devices CRUD + cross-user 404, pairing new+claim + invalid code, sessions listing, WebSocket relay: agent frame relayed to controller + control events accepted + session logged + demo agent online + invalid tokens rejected on both /ws/agent and /ws/control). Frontend Expo web preview: login->Devices navigation, Demo Host ONLINE badge, Connect->remote-canvas with status overlay disappearing (live JPEG frames streaming), toolbar (viewer-rightclick-toggle, viewer-keys-toggle -> special-key chips, viewer-keyboard-toggle) all functional, viewer-disconnect returns to devices, Settings shows demo@anycontrol.io + logout returns to login, Add Device screen displays 9-digit pairing code + 6-char OTP. Demo agent was restarted (was not running) before viewer test. No blocking issues; only one minor RN web deprecation warning (props.pointerEvents).

react_native_issues.issue: Warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/viewer/[deviceId].tsx lines 238, 257, 278 (topBar/keysWrap/toolbar Views). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Move pointerEvents="box-none" from props to style.pointerEvents on the top bar / keys wrap / toolbar Views in /app/frontend/app/viewer/[deviceId].tsx to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses @app.on_event startup/shutdown which are deprecated in FastAPI >=0.109 — consider migrating to lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
Relay is single-process in-memory; correct for MVP but note it will not scale horizontally.
add-device screen only shows the newly minted OTP; if user backgrounds/returns they must Generate new code — behavior is fine and documented via 'Expires in 10 minutes'.
seed_data_creation: No additional seed. Test users are TEST_-prefixed and disposable; a couple of TEST_ users/devices remain in Mongo (safe to ignore).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo agent must be running for viewer/relay tests: `cd /app/agent && nohup python agent.py --server http://localhost:8001 --demo > /tmp/agent.log 2>&1 &`. WebSocket tests hit ws://localhost:8001 directly (ingress WS also works but local is more deterministic). Run backend suite with: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_anycontrol_backend.py -o addopts=''
